reason: I have one or two chairs and I cut most of the hair myself, so stylist selfies, attendance and drawer checks are for a bigger salon than mine. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is too much for that when apps like Zylu or MioSalon already do billing and WhatsApp bills for less.
objection: Why should I pay a setup fee and ₹12,000 a year for a branded app when my chair is mostly me, and cheaper salon apps already send WhatsApp bills and reminders?
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a small-salon plan around ₹399 a month with just billing, WhatsApp reminders and the wallet, with my logo so it looks modern to customers.
